tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rdo rje gtum po'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa man ngag gi snye ma/ 1$0000300na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/

rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig bsdus rdo rje 'dzin/ khyod mtshan thos pa'i mod la mi bsrun snying*// lkog mar 'phrog na tshul 'di nyams len par// mi bsrun dregs pa'i sbyor bas ci ste rdzi// de ltar nges shes thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas// skyabs sems sngon 'gro'i cho ga nyams bstar nas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sngags kyis 'khor 'das sbyang*// de nas brjod bral rig pa'i rang mdangs las// snod kyi 'jig rten dag pa'i zhing gi khams// lcang lo can gyi gzhal yas khang chen por// gyur pa'i dbus su dregs pa klu gnyan khrir// pad nyi'i gdan la rang rig hūm̐ yig las// mthing mdog rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yi// 'od kyis 'phags mchod mthu dbang dngos grub bsdus// dregs pa tshar bcad sems can bde la bkod// de nyid yongs gyur bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bgrad// sbom thung gsus 'phyang gzi brjid me ltar 'bar// phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar// g.yon pa klu bdud sbrul nag zhal du gsol// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum sgeg cing dpa' ba'i skur// klu rigs bzhi sogs 'bar ba'i chas kyis spras// drag chen khros pa'i nyams dang ldan pa yi// gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer 'bar ba las// 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bdag dang gnyis med gyur// slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// dbang lha rigs lnga sras bcas spyan drangs mchod// de bzhin gshegs rnams bdag la dbang bskur gsol// zhes pas gsol btab dbang lhas bum pa'i chus// dbang bskur sku gang sgrib dag chu'i lhag ma// spyi bor gang las mi bskyod bdag por gyur// slar yang snying gar nyi steng thugs rdo rje// hūm̐ yig gis mtshan mtha' skor sngags phreng rnams// g.yas su 'khor las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod// sems can don byas dregs pa ma lus bsgral// snang grags lha sngags dag pa rab 'byams dang*// rang rig gdod ma'i gsang bdag ngo bor gyur// oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/

thun mthar snod bcud 'od zhu rang la thim// bdag nyid thugs ka'i hūm̐ las gyen rdzogs su// mi dmigs spros kun zhi ba'i ngang du thim// hūm̐ gis rtag mtha' phaṭa kyis chad mtha' bsal// slar yang thun mtshams lha dang gzhal yas su// snod bcud dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lor sbyang*// 'di dge legs byas nyin mor byed 'od kyis// ma rungs bdud sde'i mun pa kun zos nas// yang dag snang ba bzhad pa'i skal bzang gis// ma gyur 'gro rnams rtag tu 'byor gyur cig / de ltar gsang bdag sgrub thabs nyung ngu 'di// mi phyed mos pa thob des bskul ba las// dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag gi dbang*// 'gyur med rdo rje zhes byas nyung ngur spel//
